WITH job_events AS (
  SELECT
    job_id,
    event_type,
    dt,
    minutes / 60 AS hours
  FROM ops.job_events
), run_hours AS (
  SELECT
    e.job_id,
    o.team,
    e.hours
  FROM job_events AS e
  LEFT JOIN ops.job_owners AS o
    ON e.job_id = o.job_id AND e.dt = o.dt
  WHERE
    e.event_type = 'finish'
)
SELECT
  job_id,
  SUM(hours) AS sum_of_hours
FROM run_hours
WHERE
  (
    team = 'data'
  ) /* Pivot filter: slicer team */
GROUP BY
  job_id;
